mapper.select: SELECT d.id, u.name, u.sex, u.phone_num, u.email, d.doc_title_id, d.depart_id, d.status FROM doctor d JOIN "user" u ON d.id = u.id
SELECT p.id, u.name, u.sex AS gender, p.birth_date, u.phone_num AS phone, p.address FROM patient p JOIN "user" u ON p.id = u.id

SELECT rr.patient_ID, u.name AS patient_name, rr.sch_ID, rr.register_time, rr.status FROM register_record rr JOIN "user" u ON rr.patient_ID = u.id
AND rr.patient_ID = #{patientId}
AND rr.register_time >= to_timestamp(#{begin}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND rr.register_time <= to_timestamp(#{end}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT dsr.id, dsr.doc_id, u.name AS doc_name, dsr.schedule_date, CASE dsr.template_id WHEN 'TIME0001' THEN '上午 08:00-12:30' WHEN 'TIME0002' THEN '下午 13:30-18:00' ELSE dsr.template_id END AS time_period, dsr.left_source_count, dsr.status FROM doc_schedule_record dsr JOIN doctor d ON dsr.doc_id = d.id JOIN "user" u ON d.id = u.id
AND dsr.doc_id = #{doctorId}
AND dsr.schedule_date >= to_date(#{begin}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND dsr.schedule_date <= to_date(#{end}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
